# Training Provenance

> Content-addressed provenance tracking for machine learning pipelines: a deduplicating artifact store, a content-addressed lineage DAG, and bit-for-bit reproducibility and integrity verification.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance

## Source

- [src/training_provenance/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/__init__.py): Training Provenance - content-addressed lineage and reproducibility tracking.
- [src/training_provenance/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/cli.py): Command line interface for training provenance.
- [src/training_provenance/codehash.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/codehash.py): Content fingerprints of the training code itself.
- [src/training_provenance/endtoend.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/endtoend.py): An end-to-end, reproduce-and-verify driver for the tracked pipeline.
- [src/training_provenance/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/evaluation.py): Summary reporting over a tracked pipeline.
- [src/training_provenance/hashing.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/hashing.py): Deterministic content addressing.
- [src/training_provenance/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/training_provenance/pipeline.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/pipeline.py): A tracked end-to-end machine learning pipeline for demonstration.
- [src/training_provenance/provenance.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/provenance.py): The provenance ledger: runs and the lineage DAG.
- [src/training_provenance/recovery.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/recovery.py): Durable, journaled execution with crash recovery.
- [src/training_provenance/reproduce.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/reproduce.py): Execution and reproducibility verification.
- [src/training_provenance/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the provenance ledger.
- [src/training_provenance/store.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/store.py): A content-addressed artifact store.
- [src/training_provenance/transforms.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/training-provenance/blob/main/src/training_provenance/transforms.py): A registry of deterministic transforms and a small tracked ML pipeline.
